final_message:
The yen receipt test passes now, and the full suite is green (18/18). Before the fix, the suite had one failure, the yen test.

**Cause:** `formatMoney` in `src/utils/money.js` divides every amount by 100. Yen has no minor unit, so ¥500 was rendered as "¥5.00".

**Fix:** In `src/payments/receipt.js`, JPY amounts are now printed as whole yen. Other currencies still go through `formatMoney`. I added a one-line comment explaining why.

**Not fixed: the same bug is in the shared helper.** `formatMoney` in `src/utils/money.js` still renders JPY wrong. Invoices, cart, and admin all use it, so any yen amount there is still off by 100x. I left it alone because the `payments-only` fence covers only `src/payments/**` and `test/payments*`. The proper fix is a per-currency decimal table in `money.js`. That needs the fence widened or an explicit OK from you. I can do it if you want.

The fix only special-cases JPY, which matches the currencies the code supports today. Adding another zero-decimal currency would need the same treatment.

I did not commit anything.
